title: Patient Hardship Discount Program Clause on Appointment Series Late-Arrival Fees
content:
Financial Assistance Office clause.

**1.** The late-arrival hardship share is 0 percent where the patient holds an approved Patient Hardship Discount Program determination whose effective date has arrived and whose expiry date has not passed at a level whose discount percentage is 75 or more, 100 percent less the level's discount percentage where such an approved determination in force discounts more than zero but less than 75 percent, and 100 percent where no approved determination is in force. The share is read as a percentage of the late-arrival basis of the Appointment Series late-arrival fee and multiplies it.

**2.** A determination is in force when it is approved, its effective date is on or before the assessment date and its expiry date is on or after the assessment date.

**3.** The records read are the patient's Patient Hardship Discount Program determination — status, effective date, expiry date — and its level's discount percentage.

**Schedule to clause 1 (hypothetical levels).**

| Level discount percentage, determination in force | Hardship share |
|---|---|
| 75 or more | 0 percent |
| 60 | 40 percent |
| 50 | 50 percent |
| 25 | 75 percent |
| none in force | 100 percent |

**Note.** A determination whose effective date is the assessment date itself is in force on that day.
